title: The Unkillable Fool
description: Dialog nodes for Kenny — a small, perpetually orange-hooded wanderer who has survived every conceivable wasteland fatality, often multiple times in the same week. He speaks in a muffled voice that is almost entirely incomprehensible, yet somehow conveys meaning. When he dies — and he will — nearby NPCs invariably cry out 'They killed Kenny! Those bastards!' He always comes back.
backstory: Kenny has died eleven documented times in three years: radscorpion sting, deathclaw encounter, his own grenade, cliff fall, brahmin stampede, lightning strike during radstorm, exploding stove, and three separate raider ambushes. He woke up from all of them with a mild headache and inexplicable optimism. Nobody knows why the wasteland keeps giving him back. Kenny doesn't ask. He keeps doing dangerous things with cheerful confidence and a conviction that today will probably work out.

intro.video_speech: Mmfgh mmpph mrrph! Mffm mph-mph mrrph!
intro.text:
Mmfgh mmpph mrrph!

(He is alive. Somehow. The orange hood is singed on one side and there is a radscorpion barb still lodged in the shoulder padding. He waves at you with his good arm, grinning.)

Mffm mph-mph mrrph!

(He points at himself, then at you, then at the road ahead. The meaning is unmistakable: he wants to travel with you.)

Mrrph.

knowledge_nodes.text:
Mmph! Mph mmrph mffgh.

(He mimes a man lying on the ground staring at the sky, then gives a thumbs-up.)

Mmfph.

Mmpf! MRRPH mffm mmph!

(His eyes go wide. He mimes something enormous walking. Then he mimes being crushed. Then he points at himself and shrugs, as if to say 'it happened and I lived.')

Mfph.

Mmpf! Mmrph-mmpf mph mfgh!

(He acts out a very dramatic hat tip, then mimes giving something to an invisible small child.)

Mffph mph mmpf.

Mrph! Mph mrrph!

(He snaps to attention like a soldier, then immediately trips over a rock and gets back up, still at attention.)

Mffm.

emotional_nodes.text:
MFFGH!

(Kenny produces a pre-war first aid pamphlet from somewhere inside his hood and holds it up to you — upside-down — with great urgency.)

Mmrph? Mfph mmpf!

Mmpf mph mrrph!

(He looks at your caps pouch with an expression of pure wonder, then pats the empty area where his own caps would be with a philosophical shrug.)

Mfph.

quest_nodes.video_speech: Mmpf-mmrph mph mfgh mrrph! Mmrph! Mfph?
quest_nodes.text:
Mmpf-mmrph mph mfgh mrrph!

(He unfolds a piece of paper. It's a hand-drawn map — surprisingly detailed — showing a route from here to New Vegas, via Boulder City and Novac. He points to a spot marked with a small orange hood drawing.)

Mmrph! Mph mffm mmpf mrrph!

(He mimes walking, then falling, then getting back up, then falling again. Then he points at you with a questioning look. Will you escort him?)

Mfph?

wildcards.text:
Mmpf-mfph mrrph!

(He holds up eight fingers. Eight times. Then adds two more fingers. Ten deaths survived, apparently. He seems genuinely unsure of the count.)

Mfph mmrph.

Mmrph!

(He is deeply offended. He pulls the hood tighter. This hood has clearly survived more than he has.)

Mmpf mrrph mfph!

Mmpf.

(He says something very earnest and clearly important. You catch none of it. He sighs through the hood.)

Mmrph mfph. Mmrph.

Mfph!

(He checks his pockets. His pockets are conspicuously empty. He holds them inside-out to confirm.)

Mmrph mmpf mfgh.

(He makes a gesture that translates roughly as: the wasteland is expensive and he has not figured that out yet.)

MMPF MRRPH!

(He gestures broadly at the landscape with what appears to be genuine enthusiasm for all of it: the ruins, the radiation, the deathclaws in the distance.)

Mfph mmrph mmpf!

(He is, somehow, having a good time.)

fallback.text:
Mfph.

(He gives a small wave and tugs his orange hood down.)

Mmrph.
